proposal.reason: Main change is new public host one-sided RMA interfaces and communicator/window semantics (numRmaCtx/numRmaSig, WaitSignal/PutSignal/Signal behavior, hostRmaSupport reporting), which fits device-api. Add enqueue for the new RMA task type and plan scheduling/launch path integration, copy-engine for the in-node CE execution and signal/wait synchronization implementation, and gin for the cross-node RMA proxy plugin/context lifecycle, memory registration, and progress-thread transport path.
